title: What the Less added sugar plan reads
standfirst: The things we read off a product when this plan is on, and what they can do.
intro: You get this lens unless you pick your own goals. It does not tell you what to eat. It re-weighs a few things we read off a product, and your score moves.
We show this because a plan that moves a score should be able to say what it read. This is the whole list.
